title: Alerts re-raise until acknowledged instead of following re-raise setting
body:
I have my high and low alerts set to re-raise every minute, but they go off until they are acknowledged. This wasn't a problem before the latest android update.

```
xDrip+ version: 14a03a7-2019.05.18

Android Version: 9
```

comments.body:
